results.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden.
results.title: The Shawshank Redemption

results.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family.
results.title: The Godfather

results.overview: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
results.title: The Godfather Part II

results.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
results.title: Schindler's List

results.overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open-and-shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions.
results.title: 12 Angry Men
